basic_info.description: Wonderful Potrero Hill home oozing with charm! Situated on the coveted North Slope, this storybook home features two bedrooms and one bathroom on the main level. The living room presents soaring ceilings and a vintage stove, and opens onto the bright dining room and breakfast area with spectacular Eastern views showcasing the Bay, Bay Bridge, and downtown skyline. The rustic, open country kitchen is delightfully furnished with butcher block countertops and terracotta tile floors, as well as a gas range and dishwasher. Around the corner is a stacked washer/dryer, and from the breakfast area, stairs lead down to the deck and garden. The attractive bathroom is appointed with a separate shower and claw-foot tub. On the lower level, entered from a separate front entrance or the garden, is an enormous family room or guest suite, outfitted with a full bath and wet bar area and offering a range of possibilities. Enjoy the sunny Potrero weather from a beautifully landscaped yard with a spacious deck and a hot tub! Generous storage spaces complete this lovely home, with great proximity to Potrero's many dining options and convenient freeway access. Easy street parking.
